page_title: BAR 3-1 ALA | Barcelona v Alaves 29/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Barcelona keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
90+3' 3 - 1 Goal! Lamine Yamal shows great vision to find Dani Olmo (Barcelona) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 3:1.
90+2' Joan Garcia (Barcelona) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
88' The referee signals a corner kick to Alaves.
88' Jon Guridi (Alaves) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
87' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
85' The game is interrupted as Jon Guridi (Alaves) is flagged offside.
84' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Pau Cubarsi is replaced by Andreas Christensen (Barcelona).
82' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Marcus Rashford (Barcelona), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
81' The referee shows the yellow card to Antonio Blanco (Alaves).
80' Substitution. Victor Parada is replaced by Toni Martinez (Alaves).
79' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Alaves was in an offside position.
78' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

78' A pass lands at the feet of Lucas Boye (Alaves) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Alaves win a corner kick.

77' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Alaves are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

77' Barcelona exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye. The linesman signals a throw-in for Alaves.
75' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Antonio Sivera comes off the line to clear the ball away.
73' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
72' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out for a corner. Barcelona can continue in their attacking effort.

71' Jules Kounde rounds off a good move with a layoff to Dani Olmo (Barcelona) inside the box, he has a clear sight of goal but sends the ball just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
71' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona).
70' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) works the corner short.
68' The substitution has been made. Ander Guevara (Alaves) has replaced Denis Suarez.
68' Eduardo Coudet has decided to make a change. Jon Guridi (Alaves) replaces Pablo Ibanez.
66' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
65' Barcelona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
65' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play and Barcelona manage to earn a corner.
62' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
62' Barcelona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pedri (Barcelona) replaces Raphinha.
60' Here comes a substitution. Robert Lewandowski is given a rest as he is replaced by Ferran Torres (Barcelona).
59' Eduardo Coudet has decided to substitute Calebe and he is replaced by Carlos Vicente (Alaves).
58' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Abderrahmane Rebbach walks off the pitch to be replaced by Carles Alena (Alaves).
57' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) rises highest from the corner and heads at goal, but his effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Antonio Sivera.
57' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) takes the corner.
56' The ball is cleared after Raphinha (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Barcelona will take a corner.
55' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
54' Marc Casado (Barcelona) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
53' Calebe (Alaves) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
53' Calebe (Alaves) is penalised for holding. Miguel Ortiz signals a set piece.
52' One of the players from Alaves times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
51' Barcelona move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.

50' Raphinha (Barcelona) latches on to a lofted pass from the free kick and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box. His effort low towards the middle of the goal is saved by the excellent Antonio Sivera.
50' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Barcelona.

48' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. It's a throw-in for Barcelona.
47' A player from Alaves takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Hansi Flick makes a half-time substitution. Jules Kounde comes on in place of Eric Garcia (Barcelona).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Marc Bernal (Barcelona) is replaced by Marcus Rashford.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Miguel Ortiz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Victor Parada (Alaves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

45+1' Big chance! A simple pass from Victor Parada left Lucas Boye (Alaves) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.

44' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) shows off his amazing technique to get in front of goal by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the right post. Nice run, but unlucky finish! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
43' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
42' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
41' The free kick from long range, taken by Alaves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
39' Nice passing game by Barcelona. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
37' Lucas Boye (Alaves) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar.
36' Marc Bernal (Barcelona) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
35' Denis Suarez (Alaves) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
32' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Ortiz had an easy-decision to make.
31' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
30' Looks like Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

26' 2 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Raphinha, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Dani Olmo (Barcelona), who beats Antonio Sivera with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
25' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.

24' Jonny Otto (Alaves) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, Joan Garcia anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Alaves.
23' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
22' Marc Casado (Barcelona) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
20' Alaves seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
19' Jonny Otto (Alaves) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
17' The Barcelona players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition.
13' Antonio Sivera (Alaves) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball has crossed the sideline. Barcelona are taking a throw-in.
10' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
8' 1 - 1 Goal! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
8' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
7' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
7' A great run by Raphinha (Barcelona) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender. Barcelona earn a corner.
5' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes.
4' Miguel Ortiz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Dani Olmo (Barcelona). A free kick is awarded to Alaves.
1' 0 - 1 Victor Parada finds Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) with a sweet pass inside the penalty box, who then smashes the ball inside the right post. What a clinical finish to make it 0:1.
1' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Alaves.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Alaves will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Miguel Ortiz.
